changelog:
Fixed: right after updating, the new version could fail to open (a different missing file each time) if something like antivirus scanning still had a brief hold on the freshly written file
The app now waits longer before auto-reopening, and retries once automatically if the first attempt closes immediately
If the app still does not reopen automatically, simply opening PUMA_Analyzer.exe manually will work -- the update itself is already complete and verified correct
